notes.title: Challenge Mode!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36933280/e193721756678f6b255ff5d42d74fd84474154c6.png[/img]

[h1]New! [/h1]
Daily Challenge is a new single-player mode that allows the [i]Sagrada [/i]community to compete against each other on a level playing field. All participating players will use the same window pattern, objectives, and tools to vie for the top score of the day. At the end of each day, top performing players earn gold, silver, or bronze badges based on their position which will decorate their name on future attempts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36933280/39c37f8b6640d9647987756329372ae3e33799a6.png[/img]
 
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock that occurred when reconnecting to a game and pressing the Join button at the same time.
[*] The feedback prompt will now properly format text as it is entered.
[/list]

As always, we appreciate your feedback and support as we continue to make Sagrada the best digital experience possible.  If you do encounter an issue or need help, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com so we can see what’s up.

And if you’re enjoying [i]Sagrada [/i], please take a moment to rate & review the game to help spread the word to other players!

Thanks for your support!

Daily Challenges are a fun new twist on classic puzzling play. See how you stack up against community competition when Daily Challenges come to [i]Sagrada[/i]!

notes.title: Sagrada Daily Challenges!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36933280/5eb307860364ce21a5097873fb0ab8ab3e3455c6.jpg[/img]

[url=https://direwolfdigital.com/news/sagrada-daily-challenges/]Looking for a new way to enjoy the stained-glass strategy of [i]Sagrada[/i]?[/url]

Starting Wednesday, August 18, community-wide Daily Challenges arrive to test your artisanal acumen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36933280/39c37f8b6640d9647987756329372ae3e33799a6.png[/img]

Each day, a new Daily Challenge presents all players with the same window pattern drawn from millions of possible combinations. To make sure that the playing field is as smooth and level as a perfectly glazed window, players will all receive the same tools and objectives, too!

Your single best performance from your first five attempts sets your score for the day. Compete to see how your masterpiece stacks up against the cunning crafters of the Sagrada community – top performers will receive gold, silver, or bronze badges to show off your skills!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36933280/0a1c461030cb3583fa121927524f0974b5ba7216.png[/img]

Daily Challenges are a fun new twist on classic puzzling play. See how you stack up against community competition when [url=https://direwolfdigital.com/news/sagrada-daily-challenges/]Daily Challenges come to [i]Sagrada[/i]![/url]

notes.title: Sagrada 1.3.11 Patch
notes.notes:
Today’s patch contains various bug fixes to Sagrada’s game play and stability! As always, we appreciate your feedback and support as we continue to make Sagrada the best digital experience possible. If you do encounter an issue or need help, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com so we can see what's up.
 
And if you're enjoying Sagrada, please take a moment to rate & review the game to help spread the word to other players!
 
Thanks for playing Sagrada!
 
Improvements: 
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where players could get stuck after completing a campaign game
[*] Updated player framerate to be consistent when their turn ends
[*] Resolved an issue where the Flux remover would return the chosen die to the bag before a new one was drawn
[*] Resolved various network issues to improve connection stability
[*] Updated saved game icons to appear correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Sagrada Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36933280/2548ccf91db95aa760aa3013fe9715bf6c61d2f5.png[/img]

[h1]Sagrada Patch 1.3.1[/h1]

We love getting feedback about your experiences playing the games we make; it helps us better understand what’s working, and what can be improved. Your feedback over the first few weeks of Sagrada‘s release led to today’s patch, which introduces a newly expanded Tutorial and improved Solo Play mode for single-player games!

[list][*][New! Solo Play & Tutorial
[*]Fixed several crashes on the playmat.
[*]Fixed an issue that occasionally prevented Achievements from unlocking.
[*]Improved the stability of online games. Players should no longer experience disconnects during games against one another.
[*]Fixed an issue where games would occasionally start using the incorrect order.
[*]Fixed translation issues in some languages.[/list]

As always, if you’re enjoying Sagrada, we’d love it if you could take a moment to leave a review on your platform of choice. And, if you run into trouble, please drop us a line at support@direwolfdigital.com so we can help.

Thanks for playing Sagrada!

notes.title: Sagrada Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Today's patch includes a handful of minor bug fixes based on your feedback:

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Remove Friend confirmation becomes back destination if user does other actions in friend menu afterwards
[*] Fixed issue where text is entered into both the Username and Password fields simultaneously during Login
[*] Fixed issue when the app is closed before the stars are shown campaign progress won't be saved
[*] Fixed issue with tool cards where user can unselect currently selected die when using a move tool and leave no die selected to move
[*] Fixed issue where panning camera during opponent's turn prevents it from returning to your window when it becomes your turn
[*] Fixed issue where resuming matches fails if user suspends app and opponent left the playmat
[*] Localization improvements[/list]

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support! If you run into trouble, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com.  And if you're enjoying [i]Sagrada[/i], please take a moment to leave a rating and review to  help spread the word!

notes.title: Welcome to Sagrada!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your support during Early Access! Your feedback has been an invaluable part of [i]Sagrada[/i]'s development, and gotten us to today where we are excited to announce that [i]Sagrada[/i] has left Early Access and is now available on worldwide on Steam, phones & tablets!

Today's release patch also brings a whole lot of bug fixes and quality of life improvements! Here’s what’s new:
[h3]Improvements[/h3][list]
[*]General improvements to AI play
[*]General improvements to the Pass & Play experience
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*]Android achievements now unlock when earned
[*]UI elements no longer overlap on 16:10 resolutions (iPad Pro Gen 3)
[*]Pass and Play prompt now scales properly in non-English languages
[*]AI now intelligently uses Flux Remover
[*]Text fields can now be progressed via Enter
[/list]

Get ready to draft some dice and craft some windows! [i]Sagrada[/i] is now live!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[i]Sagrada[/i] is now available in Early Access!

While we're in Early Access, you may encounter a handful of issues that we're working to address before the final build of the finished game. If you do run into trouble, please let us know at Support@DireWolfDigital.com so we can help.

And if you're enjoying [i]Sagrada[/i], please take a moment to leave a review to let us know. (It helps other players discover the game, and we certainly appreciate it.)

Thanks for your support, and have fun with [i]Sagrada[/i]!

- The Dire Wolf Team
